entries.290d6427046f6863: This is a single business related to the development and operation of pay-by-time parking lots. There are no business segments requiring separate disclosure; the business is classified by operating format into "Leased Parking," "Owned Parking" and "Other." Sales results for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥14,091 million for Leased Parking, ¥2,907 million for Owned Parking and ¥631 million for Other. As of September 30, 2025, 2,598 locations with 48,232 parking spaces were in operation.
